Subject: Pipeline truthing + board evidence pull (ARR & bookings)

Team —

We need a quick but defensible sweep of Q4 pipeline and booking evidence for the board packet next week. Primary asks:

1) Confirm which deals are in-commit vs. best-case (update stage in CRM + add an evidence link in the notes).
2) For every in-commit deal that contributes to ARR or bookings in our Q4 corridor, attach or link one of: signed SOW, customer email committing to PO, or procurement acknowledgement.
3) If a deal is relying on pending redlines/counterparty approvals, mark it as "conditional" and add expected sign date.

I'm attaching a lightweight tracker (Q4_forecast_evidence.xlsx). Please do the following by EOD Monday:
- Sales rep: update stage and put one-line assurance ("sales attests - customer confirmed 11/30 via email") in the evidence cell.
- Ops/Rev: flag any disconnects to me directly.

This is about getting the board ARR corridor right and making our bookings claims auditable. If we can't produce supporting evidence for a commit, we should gate it from the ARR number and move to best-case.

I'll host a 20m truthing call Monday 10:00-10:20 PT to run high-risk deals — invite to follow.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
